sentences.text:
Hon'ble Sanjay Kumar Singh,J.
1- Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned Additional Government Advocate representing the State and perused the record.

2- By means of this second bail application under Section 439 of Cr.P.C., applicant Amzad, who is involved in Case Crime No. 183 of 2022, under Sections 363, 376 IPC and Section 3/4 POCSO Act,
police station Baghpat, district Baghpat seeks enlargement on bail during the pendency of trial.
3- The first bail application of the applicant was rejected vide order dated 18.01.2023 passed by this Court in Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. 37559 of 2022.

sentences.text: 1 4- Main substratum of argument of learned counsel for the applicant is that the applicant has been falsely implicated in this case and he has been languishing in jail sine 06.05.2022 but till date, his trial has not yet been concluded, therefore, considering his detention period, he may be enlarged on bail.

5- Per contra, learned A.G.A. for the State vehemently opposed the prayer for bail of the applicant by contending that allegation of rape has been levelled against the applicant, which is heinous in nature, therefore, considering the gravity of offence, his bail application is liable to be rejected.
6- Having heard learned counsel for the parties and examined the matter in its entirety, I find that vide order dated 17.01.2025, a report was called for from the concerned Presiding Officer, who, in compliance thereof, submitted report dated 28.01.2025 alongwith statement of the victim recorded before the trial Court.
In the said report, it is mentioned inter alia
that till date, statements of three prosecution witnesses have been recorded.
On 01.04.2024, examination-in-chief of Shabnam was recorded as PW-2 but learned counsel for accused-applicant did not cross-examine her.

Hence,
opportunity of cross-examination was closed.
On 26.11.2024 examination-in-chief of the victim was recorded but counsel for the accused-applicant did not appear for her cross-examination

, therefore,
further date has been fixed.
From perrusal of the examination-in-chief of the victim, I find that the victim has supported the prosecution case making allegation of rape against the applicant.

7- Considering the overall facts and circumstances of the case as well as keeping in view the submissions advanced on behalf of parties, gravity of offence and role assigned to applicant, I do not find any good ground to release the applicant on bail.
7- Accordingly, the bail application is rejected.
8- It is made clear that the observation contained in the instant order is confined to the issue of bail and shall not affect the merit of the trial.

10- Superintendent of Police, Baghpat is directed to ensure production of remaining prosecution witnesses on the dates fixed before the trial Court, so that trial of the applicant may be concluded at the earliest.

11- On appearance of the prosecution witnesses, trial Court shall record their statements on the same day without granting any adjournment to either of the parties and shall also make an endeavour to conclude the trial of the applicant expeditioulsy.
11- A copy of this order be communicated to the Superintendent of Police, Baghpat and the trial Court within a week for information and compliance.
Order Date :- 10.2.2025
